_doc: Triggering eval set per Skill creation best practices §5. Each query is labelled should_trigger and assigned to train or val. should-trigger passes if trigger-rate > 0.5; should-not passes if trigger-rate < 0.5. Run each query ~3x (nondeterministic) and record booleans in a results file keyed by id, then score with score_triggering.py. Near-misses share keywords (review/PR/merge/test/architecture/diagnose) but need a DIFFERENT skill or aren't code review.
